description: Calculate discount for a wallet at a merchant. Checks on-chain balances and returns tier and discount percentage per token, never raw balance amounts. Free: does not consume credits. Takes an EVM, Solana or XRPL wallet. An rpc_failure error (503) means a read did not complete: retry, and never treat it as not eligible. The check carries no proof of wallet control, so totalDiscount is what an unproven wallet gets; walletTerms gives the store's terms, and discountIfProven (when present) is what signing would get.
name: insumer_check_discount
